entries.title: Expanding Star Nursery and Supernova Collapse
entries.description: A glowing gas sphere spawns small orbiting proto-stars that grow, eject particle jets, then one reaches a mass threshold and rapidly collapses into a dense core with a bright supernova shell that expands, fades, and leaves labeled debris trails.
entries.seed: Expanding Star Nursery and Supernova Collapse: A glowing gas sphere spawns small orbiting proto-stars that grow, eject particle jets, then one reaches a mass threshold and rapidly collapses into a dense core with a bright supernova shell that expands, fades, and leaves labeled debris trails.

entries.title: Cell Division and Apoptosis Arena
entries.description: Semi-transparent cells slowly grow, replicate DNA as inner spinning strands, then split into two labeled daughter cells while others receive a signal to shrink, wrinkle, and collapse into fading particle clouds.

entries.title: Galaxy Formation and Black Hole Core
entries.description: A rotating cloud of colored particles condenses into spiral arms with bright star clusters, while the dense center collapses into a black sphere that pulls in nearby stars, curving their orbits and leaving spiraling trails that vanish past an event horizon.

entries.title: Bridge Construction and Controlled Demolition
entries.description: Cranes (boxes with extending arms) assemble a truss bridge beam by beam across a gap, then timed explosive spheres trigger, joints detach, and the structure buckles, falls, and breaks into labeled fragments that bounce and slide.

entries.title: Bubble Birth and Pop Field
entries.description: A flat liquid surface emits shimmering transparent bubbles that rise, grow, merge, and form short-lived clusters until reaching a size where they thin, wobble, then collapse into tiny splash particles that briefly mark the surface.

entries.title: Planetary Accretion and Impact Fragmentation
entries.description: Small rocky spheres orbit a star, collide, and stick to form a growing protoplanet with a changing radius meter, then a large incoming body hits, causing chunks to detach, scatter, and either re-accrete or escape with colored fragment trails.

entries.title: Urban Growth and Building Implosions
entries.description: A gridded plane gradually fills with extruded box-buildings that grow floor by floor, gain labels and colors for age, then selected old towers are rigged and implode inward, collapsing neatly into compact rubble piles.

entries.description: A gas cloud condenses into a pulsing protostar that stabilizes, expands into a red giant phase with a swollen, semi-transparent outer layer, then sheds that layer as an expanding colored shell, leaving a small hot white dwarf core.
